AppRelease.title: AppRelease
AppRelease.description: Publicly readable cloud release and realtime accent theme config broadcast from DenDev Studio.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the studio admin who created the release notice.

targetVersion.description: Target release version displayed to users (e.g., 2.1).

releaseNotes.description: Changelog summary shown in the update announcement dialog.

appTitle.description: Customized app display title for this release.

accentTheme.description: Realtime accent color theme enum key (e.g., GOLD, SKY, EMERALD, LAVENDER, CORAL, CRYSTAL).

isAvailable.description: Whether the update dialog is currently active for users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VipAccessEntry.title: VipAccessEntry
VipAccessEntry.description: Email allowlist entry granting free Danny Weather PRO 14-day forecast access.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the studio admin who added this VIP email.

email.description: Normalized lowercase Google email address granted free PRO access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when added (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Server-managed role marker granting release management access.

/app_releases/{releaseId}.description: Publicly readable release announcements and realtime accent theme config (canonical document id: latest), managed exclusively by DenDev Studio admins.

/vip_access/{vipId}.description: VIP email whitelist managed by admins; each verified signed-in user may only query their own normalized email.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Read-only admin authorization allowlist keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
